charts.name: Cycle Time Scatter Plot
charts.description: A scatter plot visualization showing cycle time distribution by agent over a time period, with dots representing individual data points and trend lines.
when_to_use: Displaying agent performance metrics over time
Visualizing cycle time trends and patterns

tables.name: Issue List View
tables.description: A compact row-based list view showing issues with priority icons, status indicators, issue IDs, titles, labels, assignee avatars, and dates.
when_to_use: Displaying a filterable list of issues or tasks
Showing issue details in a scannable format
Code review and PR status tracking

tiles.name: Issue Card
tiles.description: A compact card component displaying issue metadata including ID, title, priority, labels, and assignee avatar in a vertical layout for kanban boards.

tiles.name: Roadmap Timeline Bar
tiles.description: Horizontal timeline bars showing project progress with milestones, solid progress sections, and projected tail extensions.
